messages.subject: Bug with integrate_ode_rk45 after updating to Stan 2.10
parts:

messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: Re: Bug with integrate_ode_rk45 after updating to Stan 2.10
parts:
Hi!

This needs to be fixed (I haven't verified yet myself yet). Could you try to use the "advanced" function call to integrate_ode_rk45 which allows you to set the absolute+relative precision along with the maximal number of steps, please? Moreover, does the integrate_ode function work for you (it does the same as integrate_ode_rk45)?

Thanks.

Best,
Sebastian
